title: Implementer brief: re-anchor the spec first and self-check before reporting

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Retrospective R2 and R4 (docs/review-2026-10-25-relay-retrospective.md). Line anchors drift as slices land, and every orchestrator re-anchored by hand. 23 of 28 relays needed a fix round; the Review FAIL notes cluster in races and handle lifetime, docs out of step with code, and tests that pass when wiring is removed. Role prompts are ork's own text (roles.prompts).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md`: a new Work step 2, Re-anchor, after the load step and before Test-first; a `## Self-check` section directly before `## Report`; a `Spec edits:` line inside report part 6 (deviations).
- `internal/roles/roles_test.go`: the two new tests. Pinned text to keep: TestImplementerSteps :314 and TestImplementerSearchAndDenialRules :339 ("re-read **Not in this slice**", "or say in the report why not", "re-grep each cited file:line in its own file"); TestReportShape :381 cuts at "\n## Report\n"; TestNoClaudeCodeOnlyMechanics :220 bans Agent tool, subagent and Bash; the first-line test.
- `internal/roles/roles.go` is unchanged (it only embeds the prompts, :29, :45-52). The brief is built in `internal/engine/brief.go:47`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestImplementerPromptReanchorsFirst: the re-anchor step comes before the implement step.
- TestImplementerPromptSelfCheck: the self-check names concurrency and handle lifetime, docs updated with code, and a test that fails when the wiring is removed, before the report section.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Edit the embedded implementer prompt only. Keep it free of Claude Code-only mechanics. Do not change the report shape (role.report-shape). Track the fix-round rate on the next waves to see whether it helps; do not claim it does.

Spec check 2026-10-25: the implementer applies the re-anchored Files and Failing tests to its own slice with slicer edit (allowed, internal/engine/perm.go:27), then lists them under `Spec edits:` in report part 6, so the reviewer and gate read a current spec. The report shape (role.report-shape, adj 58) does not change. Steps 5 (mutation check) and 8 (docs) already cover wiring and docs; the self-check names them and adds concurrency and handle lifetime. Tests assert index("Re-anchor") < index("Test-first") and index("## Self-check") < index("\n## Report\n").

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/roles ./internal/engine; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
